changelog: **Mentor application screening (#1807):** additive nullable columns on `MentorApplication` — `screeningChecklist` (Json, `{ item: { done, by, at } }` over `SCREENING_ITEMS`), `interviewAt`, `interviewNotes`, `referenceName`, `referenceContact`, `referenceOutcome`, `screenedById`. `PATCH /api/mentor-applications/[id]/screening` records it (ADMIN only, each tick server-stamped with who/when, `logActivity` names the item never the text). The org setting `mentorScreeningRequired` (edited via `/api/mentor-applications/screening-policy`) lists items that must be done before approval; the approve handler re-reads the checklist inside its transaction and answers `409 screening_incomplete` with `missing`. Empty policy (default) = approval unchanged. The rule is pure in `src/lib/mentorScreeningRule.ts`. Queue rows show screening progress and "ready to decide". Interview notes and reference details are erased with the application (`accountErasure`, `sanitize-db`). Nothing reaches the applicant.

en: Admins can record a screening for each mentor application — references, interview, checklist — and require chosen checks before approval.
tr: Yöneticiler artık her mentor başvurusu için ön eleme kaydı tutabilir — referans, görüşme, kontrol listesi — ve onaydan önce seçtikleri kontrolleri zorunlu kılabilir.
de: Admins können zu jeder Mentoren-Bewerbung eine Prüfung festhalten – Referenzen, Gespräch, Checkliste – und ausgewählte Prüfpunkte vor der Freigabe verlangen.
